review:
A genuinely original idea: a 5x5, 25-line grid with a Rotate symbol fixed in the middle. When it fires, the whole grid turns 90° clockwise, shuffling every symbol into a new spot and creating new wins.

Fire, water, wind and earth symbols with a flower scatter. Free spins bring even more rotations. Medium-low volatility, a 5,000x max and an excellent 97.19% RTP. Free spins about once every 176 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.19% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
